metrics.definition: New users meeting the target customer profile per week
New accounts completing the first value event within 7 days divided by new accounts
Eligible trials converting to an active paid subscription
Active recurring subscription revenue recognized for the period
Beginning recurring revenue plus expansion minus contraction and churn divided by beginning recurring revenue
Failed recurring payments recovered within the recovery window
Completed customer workflows divided by started workflows, excluding test traffic
Material payment records requiring correction divided by material payment records
Median time from incident start to detection
Median time from incident detection to service recovery
Material production claims linked to Class A or Class B evidence divided by all material production claims
Elapsed time from Approval Pending to Approved to Send, by deal and period
Open Approval Pending deals grouped by age bucket
Deals approved without rejection, reapproval, or quote-version restart divided by approval submissions
Deals with all required evidence for each controlled gate divided by deals reaching that gate
Deals where owner, approver, payment initiator, or reconciliation reviewer violates role separation
Sent quotes with exact customer acceptance divided by sent quotes, excluding expired and canceled records
Deals requiring approval again after a quote, discount, scope, or term change divided by approved deals
Elapsed time between exact customer acceptance and invoice issuance
Elapsed time between invoice issuance and authenticated settlement evidence
Payments in failed, disputed, or refunded states divided by payment attempts in the same environment
Deals with matched or cleared three-way reconciliation divided by reconciliation-ready deals
Age of unresolved reconciliation exceptions from opening to resolution or rollback
Deals blocked by duplicate transaction or other explicit no-go control divided by attempted closes
Closed or invoiced deals requiring rollback or amendment divided by closed or invoiced deals
Material state changes with complete actor, timestamp, correlation, prior-state, next-state, and metadata evidence divided by material state changes
Inbound integration events that fail signature, idempotency, ordering, or processing checks divided by received events
Elapsed time from provider event first-seen to accepted processing outcome

rules: Do not count internal ledger constants, document repetition, or generated narratives as revenue or balance metrics.
Every metric must record period, environment, owner, query or source reference, and data-quality status.
Test and live traffic must remain separated.
A missing source reference makes a metric provisional, not verified.
